bibl.title: Ungleicharmige Waagen im literarischen, epigraphischen und papyrologischen Befund der Antike.
bibl.seg: Dirk Rohmann, Ungleicharmige Waagen im literarischen, epigraphischen und papyrologischen Befund der Antike.
bibl.note: Investigates the terminology that was used to describe different types of weighing scales, arguing that the Latin term statera was not regularly associated with the steelyard (unequal-arm balance), notwithstanding its explicit description by Vitruvius as such. Instead, it was used to refer to small or precise scales (that derive their name from the unit of stater). - See in part. pp. 105-106: Der Alternativname campana [in Greek and Coptic papyri].
